src: 4-connected red objects s embedded in blue or teal carrier regions
path: horizontal slide inside s's carrier region; blue carriers send s right until its bbox is flush with the region's right edge, teal carriers send s left until its bbox is flush with the region's left edge
trajectory: move only the final red object position, preserving shape and rows
transform: clear s.old cells to their carrier color; keep the blue and teal carrier regions otherwise unchanged
